rationale: A standard-tier rush panel order has arrived with 24 hours of slack, and we have three feasible ways to fit it into the press plan. SCN-C serves the rush order earlier than the baseline option (SCN-A) while keeping changeover and energy costs much lower than the aggressive resequencing in SCN-B. This choice slightly delays one housing run but maintains good labor balance and overall efficiency without impacting any tier-1 commitments.
